No melody, no vocals, cinematic monster reveal.

muzik/b5_donusum_tam.desc: B5 dönüşüm altyapısı: muzik/b5_donusum (ElevenLabs Music) 0-13 sn + efekt/korku_drone (kendi sentezimiz) yükselen bölüm; 17.18 sn'de kükremeyle keskin kesilir, sonrası sessiz. -18 LUFS.

muzik/b6_safak.desc: ElevenLabs Music: Original instrumental film score cue for the quiet morning after a night of terror: sad yet peaceful, tender and healing. Solo soft felt piano with warm sustained string ensemble, slow tempo around 60 bpm, B minor resolving to D major. Opens very sparse and fragile with single piano notes over a soft string drone, gradually adds cello and violins, swells gently into an emotional warm climax around 26 to 36 seconds with full sustained strings and rich piano chords, then settles into a calm, hopeful, quiet resolution and soft fade. No vocals, no percussion, no drums, intimate and cinematic.

muzik/b7_sofra_komik.desc: ElevenLabs Music: Original instrumental underscore for a Turkish family comedy web series, an evening at home between a strict mother and her cheeky daughter: playful pizzicato strings, bouncy clarinet melody, light woodblock and soft finger snaps, warm and affectionate, about 110 bpm, F major, energetic from the very first second with small comedic stops. At about 22 seconds the music suddenly thins out into one single held high violin note over a low suspense drone, unresolved, for a cliffhanger. No vocals, no drums kit. | Ölçüm: 0-24 sn oynak pizzicato/klarnet, 24-25 sn söner; istenen 'asılı nota' ÇIKMADI (kanca için efekt/el_asili_nota). -17,5 LUFS.

muzik/b8_anlatim.desc: ElevenLabs Music: Slow mysterious underscore for a night scene where a wise old shopkeeper draws circles and lines on paper and reveals an ancient secret, like telling a dark fairy tale. Starts almost silent with a very low warm sub-bass drone and a soft dark pad. Around 8 seconds a faint, slow, slightly detuned celesta motif enters. Low strings slowly swell and the tension grows steadily the whole time, building into a big ominous crescendo that peaks at 27 seconds, then stops abruptly, dead silence after. No drums, no percussion, no vocals. Eerie, wise, hushed, dark, cinematic.
